url.description: The base URL to process. If empty and --url-file is not used, components in 'components' must form a valid URL.

output_mode.description: The primary output mode: 'json' for JSON output, 'get' for formatted text extraction.

output_format.description: Format string for --get or empty for --json.

urlencode.description: If true, output URL encoded components in --get or --json mode.

idn_mode.description: International Domain Name handling: 'idn' for Unicode output, 'punycode' for ASCII output, 'none' for no change.

keep_port.description: If true, retain default port numbers in the output.

default_port.description: If true, use scheme's default port if not specified in URL.

no_guess_scheme.description: If true, disable libcurl's scheme guessing for URLs without a scheme.

sort_query.description: If true, sort query parameter pairs alphabetically.

accept_space.description: If true, accept spaces in URL and encode them as %20.

quiet.description: If true, suppress warnings and notes.

verify.description: If true, return error if URL cannot parse.

components.description: List of URL components to set using --set. Keys are component names (scheme, user, password, host, port, path, query, fragment, zoneid). Value is the data to set. Empty string clears component.

appends.description: List of data to append using --append. Keys are 'path' or 'query'. Value is the data to append.

qtrims.description: List of query keys or prefixes (with trailing *) to remove from query string using --qtrim.

replaces.description: List of query key/value pairs to replace using --replace. Key is query key, Value is new value.

replace_appends.description: List of query key/value pairs to replace or append using --replace-append. Key is query key, Value is new value.

url_file.description: Filename to read URLs from. Use '-' for stdin. If empty, URLs are provided via --url or components.

iterations.description: List of iterations to generate multiple URLs. Key is component name, Values is a list of space-separated items.

query_separator.description: Character used to separate query pairs. Default is '&'.

redirect.description: URL or path to redirect to. If empty, no redirection is performed.
